primitives.name: Exclusive Work Claiming Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Claim before you start.** Set `Owner` and `Status: CLAIMED` in the same commit that begins the work.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'Owner': 'agent identifier (string)', 'Status': 'state enum {OPEN, CLAIMED, BLOCKED, ON HOLD, UNPUSHED, DONE, CANCELLED}', 'CommitSHA': 'hex string (7+ characters)'}
primitives.assumptions: All agents must read ledger before acting; no agent may act on unclaimed rows.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Collision occurs when two agents claim same row without coordination.

layer2.mapping: Ledger row state transition maps to Bayesian belief update over agent intentions; claimed rows represent updated posterior beliefs about task ownership.
layer2.telemetry: Commit SHA and Owner field consistency verified via CI guard.

primitives.name: Status Transition Guard
primitives.verbatim_quote: **`DONE` requires evidence.** Put a commit SHA (7+ hex chars) or a `#123` PR reference in `Evidence`.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'Evidence': 'commit SHA or PR reference (string)', 'Status': 'state enum {OPEN, CLAIMED, BLOCKED, ON HOLD, UNPUSHED, DONE, CANCELLED}'}
primitives.assumptions: Only claimed rows may transition to DONE; evidence must be verifiable.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Invalid DONE transition without evidence causes CI failure.

layer2.mapping: Guard enforces deterministic finite automaton over task lifecycle; evidence acts as tokenized proof of completion.
layer2.telemetry: CI script validates Evidence field presence and format against expected patterns.

primitives.name: Collision Prevention Mechanism
primitives.verbatim_quote: On 2026-08-19 that cost three separate collisions in one day: - Copilot and Hermes each built the same fabricated `signup-workflow` feature, independently, neither knowing the other had.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'Collision': 'boolean flag indicating concurrent work on same task', 'WorkUnit': 'unique identifier for task row'}

Agents must claim rows atomically before beginning work, ensuring mutual exclusion. The guard mechanism enforces valid state transitions, particularly requiring evidence for DONE status. This structure prevents race conditions and ensures reproducible builds by making all agent interactions explicit in Git. The system dualizes into a Bayesian model where each claim updates belief about task ownership, and into a temporal logic framework where transitions are constrained by guards.
